name: bloxstack
description: Connect your AI assistant to BloxStack and see what your Roblox studio is working on.

interface.longDescription: Connect your AI assistant to your team's BloxStack workspace. Choose a studio, approve its permissions and get a first briefing on the games and tasks your team is working on. Read-only access is enough to get started.
defaultPrompt: Connect my BloxStack studio and tell me what our team is working on.
